edits.old: Prominence estimates the percentage of the complete post’s semantic meaning represented by the supplied mask.
edits.new: Compare how much of the complete post’s semantic meaning is represented by each of two supplied masks.

edits.old: The input is a JSON object. "mask" contains the selected text fragments as an array of strings. "marked_post" contains the complete post, with those same selections enclosed in ⟦ and ⟧.
edits.new: The input is a JSON object with two masks, "A" and "B", from the same post. Each contains "mask", the selected text fragments as an array of strings, and "marked_post", the complete post with those same selections enclosed in ⟦ and ⟧.

edits.old: Determine what the fragments jointly express on their own:
edits.new: For each mask, determine what its fragments jointly express on their own:

edits.old: Within the same post, selections expressing the same meaning should receive similar scores.
edits.new: Selections expressing the same meaning should be treated as equivalent.

edits.old: Choose an integer from 0 through 100, where 0 means the mask represents none of the post’s meaning and 100 means it represents all of it.
edits.new: Decide which mask preserves more of this post’s meaning. Choose "A" or "B", "tie" if they preserve equivalent amounts, or "uncertain" if you cannot determine the comparison. Do not assign numerical scores.

edits.old: Return only a JSON object with one integer field, "prominence".
edits.new: Return only a JSON object with two fields: "explanation" (briefly explain the meaningful difference between the masks and why it matters to this post) and "preserves_more" ("A", "B", "tie", or "uncertain").
